# FilePilot

> Free, privacy-first, browser-based tools for PDF, image, and file conversion. All processing happens locally in the browser — no files are uploaded to any server.

Canonical site: https://www.filepilot.space/
Sitemap: https://www.filepilot.space/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://www.filepilot.space/robots.txt

## PDF Organization Tools

- [Merge PDF Files Online – Free & Private | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/merge/): Combine multiple PDF files into one document. 100% free, secure, and client-side only.
- [Split PDF Online – Extract Pages Free | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/split/): Split PDF documents or extract specific pages. Fast, free, and secure browser-based tool.
- [Organize PDF Pages – Reorder, Rotate, Delete | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/organize-pdf/): Reorder, rotate, and delete PDF pages with drag-and-drop thumbnails. Everything stays private in your browser.
- [Rotate PDF Pages Online – Free & Private | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/rotate-pdf/): Rotate all pages of a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees. 100% browser-based, no uploads.
- [Delete PDF Pages Online – Free & Private | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/delete-pages/): Remove specific pages from your PDF instantly in the browser. Enter page numbers or ranges. 100% private — no uploads.
- [Extract PDF Pages Online – Free & Private | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/extract-pages/): Pull out specific pages from a PDF into a new document. Browser-based, private.
- [Reverse PDF Pages Order – Free & Private Online Tool | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/reverse-pdf/): Reverse the page order of your PDF instantly in the browser. No uploads, 100% private and free. Great for reading books and documents in reverse.
- [Add Blank Page to PDF – Insert Empty Page Online Free | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/add-blank-page/): Insert a blank page at the beginning, end, or any position in your PDF. 100% private — processed in your browser.
- [Alternate Merge PDFs – Interleave Pages from Multiple PDFs | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/alternate-merge/): Interleave pages from two or more PDFs in alternating order. Perfect for combining front and back scans. 100% private — browser only.
- [N-Up PDF – Multiple Pages Per Sheet Online Free | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/n-up-pdf/): Put multiple PDF pages on one sheet — 2-up, 4-up or 9-up. Free N-up PDF tool that runs in your browser with no file uploads.
- [Overlay / Underlay PDFs – Stamp One PDF Over Another | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/overlay-pdf/): Layer one PDF on top of or behind another. Perfect for adding letterheads, watermarks, or background templates. 100% private.

- [Grid Combine PDFs – Arrange Multiple PDFs in a Grid Layout | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/grid-combine/): Arrange first pages of multiple PDFs in a grid layout. Create comparison sheets or overviews. 100% private — browser only.
- [Posterize PDF – Tile Large Pages for Poster Printing | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/posterize-pdf/): Split a large PDF page into printable tiles and assemble a full-size poster on a normal printer. Free, browser-based, no file uploads.
- [Add Page Labels to PDF – Roman Numerals & Prefixes | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/add-page-labels/): Add custom PDF page labels — Roman numerals, letters, or prefixes like A-1. Free browser-based tool, no uploads and no signup.
- [PDF Metadata Editor - View, Edit and Remove PDF Metadata | FilePilot](https://www.filepilot.space/pdf-metadata/): View, edit, or remove all PDF metadata including title, author, keywords, and dates. 100% private, processed locally in your browser.
